comparison.objective: Air-test a handhole before conditionally removing its cover bolts; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed probe placement, condition-dependent restraint, and bolt removal versus bimanual screen handling and granular bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Valid continuous 60 s sample followed by alarm-dependent bolt/cover outcome versus mass recovery, washer retention, no loss/damage, and released screen dwell.
comparison.reason: The handhole task tests safety sequencing and fastener manipulation, not selective material flow.
